Yara: Opened PR to add a short section about resumable streams, dedupe on reconnect, and a clear streaming vs pagination sentence. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4125. Can folks sanity-check?

Luca: Looks good. Suggest 1-line summary: "Streams = incremental deltas (transient cursors); Pagination = stable pages via next_token."

Mina: Added a tiny Python resume + dedupe example:
```python
cursor = last_cursor
seen = set(last_n_ids)
for chunk in client.stream_resume(cursor=cursor):
    if chunk.id in seen: continue
    process(chunk.text)
    seen.add(chunk.id)
    cursor = chunk.cursor
```
Callout: keep a small dedupe window (e.g., 32 ids). Cursors may expire.

Luca: TS snippet mirrors that with async iterator and notes not to parse the cursor. Also added a 2-line pseudocode for exponential backoff on RATE_LIMIT.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4125  build passed :white_check_mark:

Yara: Action items: Mina to add the dedupe-window sentence to the top, Luca to add cursor-expiry note, I'll merge after CI. Ping for final read. :rocket:
